title: Page 4
content_zh:
当然自己养大的儿子是不会犯错的，那错肯定就在新媳妇身上。

于是，谢母更顺理成章地厌恶起原宜之。

原宜之自然不知道自己辛苦陪着婆婆还落了个埋怨，此时她勉强睁开眼睛，迷离地看了眼前的男人一眼，还没意识到他是谁，鼻子里倒先闻进了扑鼻的清香，不由食指大动。

白天她几乎没吃什么东西，沐浴后也只是稍微吃了两口，到现在是真的饿了，看着桌子上色香味俱全的鸭血粉丝汤，她终于完全清醒过来，眨眨那双秋水般的明眸，原宜之抬头对着谢雍灿然一笑，登时如春花绽放美不胜收，让谢雍几乎闪了眼。

原宜之坐正身子，才又发觉自己身上还多了件厚披风，她又对谢雍笑了笑，道：“谢谢夫君。”

谢雍在她对面坐下，不动声色地‘嗯’了声，说：“趁热吃吧。”

鸭血粉丝汤是金陵名产小吃，制作却相当简单，将粉丝盛在小竹篓里，放到烧得滚沸的老鸭汤里烫熟后，将粉丝倒入碗中，放入鸭血、鸭肠、鸭肝、葱花、香菜和其它调味料，然后再浇上老鸭汤，小小一碗汤，就将鸭的美味全部包含其中了。

劳累了一天，又熬夜了半宿，在这深秋之夜，能够得到一碗清淡又开胃的夜宵，对于原宜之来说真是莫大的享受。

虽然饿极，原宜之吃得依然优雅秀气，吃到一半还对谢雍笑道：“比我平时吃的口味还好呢，明天我要赏赐厨娘。”

原宜之和其它闱阁女子不同，她不爱吃甜点，偏爱略带咸味的点心和小吃，最爱吃的就是这金陵鸭血粉丝汤，原府特意为她从外面聘请了一个擅长做这道汤的厨娘，原宜之出嫁的时候甚至想把那厨娘带来做陪嫁呢。

她以为原府的这道汤已经堪称一绝，却万万没想到谢家居然能品尝到比原府更美味的汤。

谢雍抬头看她，见她吃得小脸红扑扑的，嘴唇红艳艳的，眼睛更是波光涟漪，谢雍眼神暗了一暗，喉头发紧，他低头再看看前面的汤碗，觉得其实远不如自己的新娘子美味诱人。

所以他只是低低地‘嗯’了一声，没有再说什么。

原宜之发现她的这位夫君总是沉默寡言，不爱说话。不过这也没什么，不爱花言巧语，只要懂得体贴照顾妻子，那更好。

原宜之偷偷地仔细瞧了谢雍一眼，意外发现他有着一双格外动人的凤眼，长眉凤目，高鼻薄唇，本是如水墨写意一般悠远秀美容貌，因这男人略带疏离的姿态和骨子里渗透出来的漫不经心的清傲，就让他天生多了几分不容侵犯的贵气凛然。

原宜之忍不住暗想，这大概是连中三元的才子独有的骄傲吧？看起来她以后要小心和他相处，千万不能再言语和行为中触犯了大才子呢。

小夫妻俩在寂静的深夜吃着美味的夜宵，偶尔抬头互望，眼波流转间暧昧暗生，原本被破坏殆尽的洞房之夜竟然也有了别样的旖旖滋味。

只有躺在一边装病人的谢母几乎恨的咬碎银牙，手指死死扭着被单，心里充满各种阴暗情绪。

前些日子儿子四处寻访厨娘，她也没当一回事，却原来都是为了讨好新媳妇才特意准备的！

瞧瞧！这大半夜的还特意为原宜之做什么鸭血粉丝汤，不嫌麻烦吗？

以往儿子熬夜处理公事，也不过是喝杯热茶，吃几块点心而已，从来不特意麻烦厨娘再去点火烧锅兴师动众。

谢母恨恨地闭上眼睛，又有点莫名的意兴阑珊，她千辛万苦地养儿子图个什么啊？

儿大不由娘，娶了媳妇忘了娘，没有一个好东西喔！

因着昨夜的好心情，原宜之第二日的精神看起来还不太差。

在谢母起床前，她和谢雍回他们的院子简单迅速地梳洗了一番，换了正式的大衣裳，准备新婚次日的叩拜之礼。

知柔取来热呼呼的烧卖、银丝卷和燕窝粥，伺候两位主子垫了垫肚子。今日的行程还很多，总不能饿着肚子去伺候老夫人。

正在这时，小丫鬟进来禀报：“老爷，夫人，少爷来请安了。”

原宜之正准备夹小菜的筷子停顿了一下，随后又若无其事地继续进餐。

谢雍的眉头不自觉地皱了皱。

按照续弦的习俗来说，应该是新娶进门的继室先跟随丈夫拜见公婆，然后再进庵堂祭拜祖先，这一套礼仪完成，新妇才算真正成为谢家人。之后，谢雍原来的妾室子女等，才能拜见新进门的主母，向她行礼问安，表示以后都要归新主母管理了。

这个顺序，是不应该也不能出错的。

现在少爷却贸贸然地过来了，这是怎么回事？

对于这种事，刚进门的原宜之不好贸然开口，尤其牵涉到原配留下的嫡子谢昭，她就更不能乱开口了，所以只是静侯谢雍的处理。

“让他进来吧。”谢雍淡淡地吩咐道。

一个苍白瘦弱的小男孩战战兢兢地走进来，因天气已转寒凉，他穿了薄棉袄裤，外面罩了大红金钱蟒缎的大褂子，脖子上还挂了个硕大的沉甸甸的长命金锁，越发显得他像个小棉球，锁比脸大。

原宜之忍不住微笑，她虽然无法发自内心地去喜爱一个别的女人为丈夫生的儿子，但不妨碍她喜爱一个漂亮的小娃娃——谢昭确实很漂亮，面庞三分像谢雍，更精致柔美的部分大概遗传自他的生母，有一双水汪汪的桃花眼。

跟在谢昭身后的是一个娇小玲珑的柔美少女，大约十五、六岁的年纪，小小的瓜子脸，与谢昭如出一澈的水汪汪的桃花眼，看人的时候怯生生的，我见犹怜。

原宜之见她梳着闺阁小姐的发型，身上的衣服也是淡雅但精致的绫罗，并非仆佣所穿的布麻织物，可是她又紧跟着谢昭，一副伺候谢昭的佣人模样，这让原宜之狐疑地再三打量了她几眼，然后回头看了看谢雍，目光中满是疑问。

不是谢雍的妾室，谢家又没有未出嫁的小姐，那这个小美人是谁？

谢雍看到少女，眼底闪过一丝不快的光，但他向来不形于色，只是冷冷扫了少女一眼，对原宜之道：“这位是谢昭的小姨，丁家的六小姐，前些日子忙乱，她过来帮忙照看谢昭的。”

丁六小姐，闺名丁锦芸，芳龄十五，是丁家的庶女。和谢昭的母亲丁锦绣同父异母。

按理说，她一位未出阁的姑娘，是不应该客居姐夫家的，但是在各方人士的推波助澜之下，才出现了现在微妙的局面。

丁锦绣去世之后，丁家自然不放心外孙谢昭，更不舍得放弃谢雍这么一个好女婿，丁士章早已退休，他的儿子又没有出息，丁家已经有了衰落之相，死死巴结住谢雍。或许好歹能沾点光，所以，丁家想再嫁一个女儿给谢雍，人选就是丁六小姐丁锦芸。

当时也有这样的传统，姐死妹继，这样不仅能继续维系原来结亲两家的两姓之好，还能最大程度上保证原配所生的子女不受后母的欺凌虐待，毕竟亲姨母就算以后有了自己的亲生子女，念在血缘的关系上，一般对前妻留下的子女也不会太过分。

特别是穷苦人家，这样的亲事还能节省聘礼嫁妆，两家都省心省事，这种续弦的方式也就更常见。

谢母原本是很讨厌丁锦绣的，可是庶女丁锦芸与嫡出的丁锦绣不同，向来乖巧柔顺，在谢家居住时很得谢母的欢心，后来谢雍打定主意要娶扫把星原宜之，让谢母大为恼火，与不讨喜的原宜之相比，丁锦芸就更显得难能可贵。
content_en:
Of course, a son raised by himself cannot make mistakes, and the fault must lie with his new wife.

Therefore, Xie's mother even more logically disliked Qi Yuan Yizhi.

Yuan Yizhi naturally didn't know that she was complaining about her hard work accompanying her mother-in-law. At this time, she reluctantly opened her eyes and glanced at the man in front of her in confusion. Before she realized who he was, she smelled the fragrant fragrance in her nose and couldn't help but twitch her index finger.

She hardly ate anything during the day, and only took a few bites after bathing. Now she was really hungry. Looking at the delicious duck blood and vermicelli soup on the table, she finally woke up completely and blinked her bright eyes like autumn water. Yuan Yizhi raised his head and smiled brightly at Xie Yong. It was so beautiful that it suddenly bloomed like spring flowers, making Xie Yong almost blink.

Yuan Yizhi sat upright and realized that she had a thick cloak on her body. She smiled at Xie Yong again and said, "Thank you, husband."

Xie Yong sat down opposite her, said "Yes" calmly, and said, "Eat it while it's hot."

Duck blood vermicelli soup is a famous snack in Jinling. It is quite simple to make. Put the vermicelli in a small bamboo basket and blanch it in the boiling old duck soup. Then pour the vermicelli into a bowl, add duck blood, duck intestines, duck liver, chopped green onion, coriander and other seasonings, and then top it with the old duck soup. A small bowl of soup contains all the deliciousness of duck.

After a tiring day and staying up half the night, it was a great pleasure for Yuan Yizhi to have a bowl of light and appetizing supper on this late autumn night.

Although he was very hungry, Yuan Yizhi still ate elegantly. Halfway through the meal, he smiled at Xie Yong and said, "It tastes better than what I usually eat. I will reward the cook tomorrow."

Yuan Yizhi is different from other Wei Ge women. She doesn't like desserts and prefers slightly salty snacks and snacks. Her favorite food is the Jinling Duck Blood Vermicelli Soup. The Yuan Mansion specially hired a cook from outside who was good at making this soup. When Yuan Yizhi got married, she even wanted to bring the cook as a dowry.

She thought that the soup in Yuanfu was already excellent, but she never expected that Xie Jia could actually taste a soup that was even more delicious than that in Yuanfu.

Xie Yong looked up at her and saw that her face was flushed from eating, her lips were red, and her eyes were rippling. Xie Yong's eyes darkened and his throat tightened. He lowered his head and looked at the soup bowl in front of him. He felt that it was not as delicious as his bride.

So he just said "hmm" in a low voice and said nothing more.

Yuan Yizhi found that her husband was always taciturn and did not like to talk.But that's okay. If you don't like sweet words, as long as you know how to be considerate and take care of your wife, that's better.

Yuan Yizhi secretly took a closer look at Xie Yong, and unexpectedly discovered that he had a pair of particularly charming phoenix eyes, long eyebrows and phoenix eyes, a high nose and thin lips. He originally had a distant and beautiful appearance like an ink painting, but because of this man's slightly alienated posture and the casual pride that permeated his bones, he was born with a bit of inviolable nobility.

Yuan Yizhi couldn't help but think to himself, this is probably the unique pride of a talented man who has won three yuan in a row, right?It seems that she must be careful when getting along with him in the future, and must not offend the talented man in her words or actions.

The young couple ate delicious late-night snacks in the silence of the night. Occasionally, they looked up and looked at each other, and an ambiguity arose in their eyes. The originally ruined wedding night actually had a different kind of charm.

Only Mother Xie, who was lying on the side pretending to be a patient, almost broke her silver teeth with hatred, twisted the sheets with her fingers, and her heart was filled with all kinds of dark emotions.

A few days ago, her son went around looking for the cook, but she didn't take it seriously, but it turned out that he had specially prepared it to please his new wife!

Look!Isn't it troublesome to make duck blood and vermicelli soup for Yuan Yizhi in the middle of the night?

In the past, when my son stayed up late to deal with official matters, he just drank a cup of hot tea and ate a few snacks. He never bothered the cook to light a fire or stir up a crowd.

Xie's mother closed her eyes bitterly, feeling a little inexplicably uninterested. Why did she work so hard to raise her son?

When a son grows up, he cannot help his mother. When he marries a daughter-in-law, he forgets his mother. There is no such thing as a good thing!

Due to his good mood last night, Yuan Yizhi's energy seemed not too bad the next day.

Before Xie's mother got up, she and Xie Yong went back to their yard to freshen up briefly and quickly, changed into formal clothes, and prepared for the wedding ceremony the day after their wedding.

Zhirou fetched hot siomai, silver rolls and bird's nest porridge, and served the two masters to pacify their stomachs.We still have a lot of schedule today, so we can't wait on the old lady hungry.

At this moment, the little maid came in and reported: "Master, madam, the young master has come to say hello."

Yuan Yizhi paused for a moment while preparing to pick up side dishes with his chopsticks, and then continued eating as if nothing had happened.

Xie Yong's brows wrinkled unconsciously.

According to the custom of continuing marriage, the newly married step-brother should first follow her husband to meet her parents-in-law, and then go into the nunnery to worship their ancestors. After this set of etiquette is completed, the bride can truly become a member of the Xie family.After that, Xie Yong's original concubines and children could meet the new mistress, salute her and say hello, saying that they would all be under the management of the new mistress from now on.

This order should not and cannot be wrong.

Now the young master has come over hastily. What's going on?

Regarding this kind of matter, Yuan Yizhi, who had just entered the house, could not speak rashly, especially if it involved Xie Zhao, the legitimate son left by his first wife, and she could not speak randomly, so it was only handled by Jinghou Xie Yong.

"Let him come in." Xie Yong ordered calmly.

A pale and thin little boy walked in cautiously. Because the weather had turned cold, he wore a thin cotton-padded jacket and trousers, and a large red money python satin gown. He also had a huge and heavy golden lock of longevity hung around his neck, which made him look more and more like a little cotton ball. The lock was bigger than his face.

Yuan Yizhi couldn't help but smile. Although she couldn't sincerely love the son born to her husband by another woman, it didn't stop her from loving a beautiful little baby - Xie Zhao was indeed very beautiful, with a face that was three-quarters like Xie Yong's. The more delicate and soft part was probably inherited from his biological mother, with a pair of watery peach blossom eyes.

Following Xie Zhao was a petite and delicate girl, about fifteen or sixteen years old, with a small oval face and watery peach eyes that mirrored Xie Zhao's. She was timid when looking at people, which made me pity her.

Yuan Yizhi saw that she had the hairstyle of a boudoir lady, and the clothes on her body were also elegant but exquisite silk, not the linen fabrics worn by servants, but she followed Xie Zhao closely, looking like a servant serving Xie Zhao, which made Yuan Yizhi look at her again and again suspiciously, and then looked back at Xie Yong, his eyes full of questions.

She is not Xie Yong's concubine, and there is no unmarried lady in the Xie family, so who is this little beauty?

When Xie Yong saw the girl, there was a flash of unhappiness in his eyes, but he never showed it. He just glanced at the girl coldly and said to Yuan Yi: "This is Xie Zhao's aunt, the sixth lady of the Ding family. She was busy the past few days, so she came to help take care of Xie Zhao."

Miss Ding Liu, whose maiden name is Ding Jinyun, is fifteen years old and the concubine of the Ding family.He has the same father as Xie Zhao’s mother, Ding Jinxiu.

Logically speaking, she, a girl who has not yet left the government, should not stay at her brother-in-law's house. However, with the help of people from all walks of life, the current delicate situation has emerged.

After Ding Jinxiu's death, the Ding family was naturally worried about their grandson Xie Zhao, and they were even more reluctant to give up such a good son-in-law as Xie Yong. Ding Shizhang had already retired, and his son had no future. The Ding family was already in decline, and they fawned over Xie Yong.Maybe they can get some light after all, so the Ding family wants to marry another daughter to Xie Yong, and the candidate is Miss Ding Liu, Ding Jinyun.

There was also a tradition at that time that if a sister dies, a sister will succeed her. This not only maintains the good relationship between the two surnames of the original married family, but also ensures to the greatest extent that the children born to the first wife will not be bullied and abused by the stepmother. After all, even if the biological aunt has her own biological children in the future, considering the blood relationship, she will generally not be too harsh on the children left by her ex-wife.

Especially for poor families, this kind of marriage can also save betrothal gifts and dowries, and both families can save worry and trouble. This method of continuing the marriage is more common.

Xie's mother originally hated Ding Jinxiu, but the concubine Ding Jinyun was different from the direct daughter Ding Jinxiu. She had always been well-behaved and docile. She was very popular with Xie's mother when she lived in the Xie family. Later, Xie Yong made up his mind to marry the broom star Yuan Yizhi, which made Xie's mother very angry. Compared with the disliked Yuan Yizhi, Ding Jinyun became even more valuable.
